segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and markets medical diagnostic products for clinical laboratory and point-of-care customers located in the Americas.
segments.evidence: The Group comprises two main geographical segments (i) the Americas and (ii) Rest of World - Ireland.

segments.name: Rest of World - Ireland
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and markets medical diagnostic products for clinical laboratory and point-of-care customers outside the Americas, including Ireland.
segments.evidence: The Group's geographical segments are determined by the location of the Group's assets and operations.

changes.text: In 2024 the company acquired the biosensor and CGM assets of Waveform Technologies, adding continuous glucose monitoring to its business.
changes.evidence: In January 2024, we acquired the biosensor and CGM assets of privately held Waveform Technologies, Inc. ("Waveform").
